items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: They had, let's see, they had Rene, they had Rene and myself, Edna Mitchell, Joe Rene, Chester Lazard, and Henry Harden, Thomas on guitar, and they had Manny Gabriel, Handy, and this boy over the river, from over the lake, ten pieces.

ctx.x: What instrument? Did he play saxophone?
He played sax. Yeah. And they had this other boy playing bass. What his name there? Lazard? Chester Lazard. Chester Lazard, yeah. Chester Lazard. He was playing bass.
That was a pretty big band, that wasn't it?
